originalTitle: A record-breaking week for options powers S&P 500 surge; volatility gauge is near 2026 low
summary: The broad market benchmark soared to records this week, benefiting from options activity and a calmer VIX.
content:
Stock market bulls got some huge affirmation this week as the S&P 500 made all-time highs, options volumes set records, and shares of this year's star IPO – SpaceX – stabilized and rallied despite its earnings report and the end of its first lockup period.

On Friday, the Cboe Volatility Index (VIX) fell to its lowest level since January as the S&P 500 added 0.6%, bringing the week's advance to 3.6%.

More than four million S&P 500 index calls traded on Cboe Global Markets Tuesday as the benchmark gauge surged above 7,700 for the first time in history. That topped the previous record for call trading in May by 10%, according to exchange data.

"That's what it used to sound like," one trader on the Cboe floor in Chicago told me after Tuesday's roaring rally, referring to when thousands of traders crammed the pits in decades past. "Sometimes it sounds like that on down days, but we were up. That was really busy."

Zero-day-to-expiry call options accounted for 2.4 million trades in the S&P 500 on Tuesday, also a record. The ratio of puts to calls among all options plunged to 0.83, the second-lowest recorded. The average is greater than 1, reflecting the primary usage of put options as hedging instruments.

Total open interest in the S&P 500 ended the week at 27.4 million contracts, in the 93rd percentile over the past year, according to Cboe. The ratio in open interest of calls is in the 95th percentile.

Where that open interest is concentrated can help give investors an idea where the stock market might find support or resistance going forward.

The most popular strike in the State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) by combined open interest of both puts and calls is the 760-strike, about 1.7% below where the fund closed on Friday, according to Barchart data. That's because of 94,000 open puts, which could create support for the market on dips that turn into profit-taking for lingering bears who just had a rough week.

On the upside, the biggest level for call buyers is the 785-strike, where there are 114,000 open calls.

"'Sell in May and go and play' is over and advisors are getting back to work as the summer ends," Ed Rumell, head of ETFs at Corgi, said in a call. "We saw a big week in the underlying options on our buffer funds as well as big activity in SK Hynix and tech trades like our flagship photonics fund."

Beaten-down semiconductor stocks jumped, with the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) advancing more than 7% on the week. The Corgi Lithography & Semiconductor Photonics ETF (EUV) added 13% in the period. Also helping the rally: The 10-year Treasury yield stopped its ascent at 4.7%

S&P 500 earnings are on pace to grow 47% in the second quarter, which would be the biggest since the rebound from Covid in 2021, according to FactSet.
chineseTitle: 期权创纪录的一周推动标普 500 指数飙升；波动率指标接近 2026 年低点
chineseSummary: 受益于期权活动和波动率指数平静，本周大盘基准飙升至历史新高。
chineseContent:
本周股市多头得到了一些巨大的肯定，因为标准普尔 500 指数创出历史新高，期权交易量创下纪录，尽管今年的明星 IPO – SpaceX – 尽管发布了盈利报告并结束了第一个禁售期，但其股价仍企稳并上涨。

周五，芝加哥期权交易所波动率指数 (VIX) 跌至 1 月份以来的最低水平，标准普尔 500 指数上涨 0.6%，本周涨幅达到 3.6%。

周二，芝加哥期权交易所全球市场上交易的标普 500 指数看涨期权超过 400 万份，基准指数历史上首次飙升至 7,700 点以上。根据交易所数据，这比 5 月份看涨期权交易的先前记录高出 10%。

“过去听起来就是这样，”周二股市大幅上涨后，芝加哥芝加哥期权交易所的一位交易员告诉我，他指的是过去几十年来成千上万的交易员挤进场内的情况。 “有时听起来像是在低迷的日子里，但我们起来了。那真的很忙。”

周二，标普 500 指数中零日到期看涨期权交易量达到 240 万笔，同样创历史新高。所有期权中看跌期权与看涨期权的比率暴跌至 0.83，为有记录以来第二低。平均值大于 1，反映出看跌期权主要用作对冲工具。

根据芝加哥期权交易所 (Cboe) 的数据，标准普尔 500 指数本周未平仓合约总数为 2,740 万份合约，位于去年的第 93%。看涨期权的未平仓合约比率处于第 95 个百分位。

未平仓头寸集中的地方可以帮助投资者了解股市未来可能在哪里找到支撑或阻力。

根据 Barchart 数据，道富 SPDR S&P 500 ETF 信托 (SPY) 中看跌期权和看涨期权未平仓合约组合中最受欢迎的行使价是 760 行使价，比该基金上周五收盘价低约 1.7%。这是因为有 94,000 手未平仓看跌期权，这可能会为市场逢低提供支撑，从而为刚刚经历了艰难一周的挥之不去的空头带来获利了结。

从好的方面来看，看涨期权买家的最大水平是 785 次行使价，其中有 114,000 个未平仓看涨期权。

Corgi ETF 主管埃德·鲁梅尔 (Ed Rumell) 在电话会议中表示：“‘五月卖出，然后去玩’已经结束，顾问们将在夏季结束后重新开始工作。” “我们看到我们的缓冲基金的基础期权本周表现强劲，SK Hynix 和我们的旗舰光子基金等科技交易也出现了巨大的活动。”

遭受重创的半导体股大幅上涨，iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) 本周上涨逾 7%。 Corgi 光刻和半导体光子学 ETF (EUV) 在此期间上涨了 13%。也有助于涨势：10年期国债收益率止住上涨至4.7%

FactSet 的数据显示，标普 500 指数第二季度盈利预计将增长 47%，这将是自 2021 年新冠疫情反弹以来的最大增幅。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
